jobPostingInfo.title: Internal Product Manager 3 - Sales Performance Management
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s Digital Experience organization in Bengaluru as a Product Manager 3 and lead one of our most important enterprise capabilities. You will manage forecasting within a connected ecosystem that includes Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, and upstream planning systems. This provides a single, reliable view of pipeline and ARR forecasts, which directly supports executive decision-making. This outstanding opportunity lets you join a world-class team and make a meaningful impact!

What You’ll Do

  • Take full responsibility for Sales Performance Management and forecasting systems from start to finish
  • Define product strategy and roadmap for pipeline visibility, forecast rollups, and data-based predictions
  • Lead cross-system integration and architecture, ensuring scalable, reliable data flows
  • Partner with Sales, RevOps, and Finance to align forecast definitions, pipeline stages, and revenue assumptions
  • Improve forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and predictability through data insights
  • Work with engineering teams to bring to bear AI/ML, LLMs, or automation frameworks (e.g., copilots, agents, orchestration tools)
  • Proven capability to outline, convey, and secure agreement on multi-year product roadmaps for platform or enterprise products

Skills Required

  • 6–8 years in Product Management, ideally within Sales Performance Management, Forecasting, RevOps, or related platforms
  • Experience owning complex, multi-system enterprise products or SPM and Forecasting platforms
  • Strong comprehension of sales pipeline oversight, sales performance tracking, and forecasting procedures
  • Strong experience partnering with engineering, architecture, and operations teams in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience managing complex, multi-system initiatives through disciplined prioritization and execution
  • Strong data and analytical abilities with experience working on data models, pipelines, and forecasting inputs
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment and roadmap execution at scale

Requirements & Product Discovery

  • Strong ability to elicit, structure, and validate business requirements through interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions with collaborators, customers, and other interested parties
  • Experience conducting fit-gap analysis (current vs. future state) to define MVP scope and strategic roadmap
  • Ability to challenge and refine requirements to ensure alignment with business value, outcomes, and scalability

Documentation & Communication

  • Expertise in crafting clear, structured product artifacts, including:

Product Requirements Documents (PRDs)

1. Business Requirements Documents (BRDs)

Process flows, journey maps, and personas

  • Ability to detail end-to-end business processes and system interactions, including downstream impacts across coordinated platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Backlog Management & Delivery Readiness

  • Proven experience translating requirements into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Strong backlog ownership, including prioritization, refinement, and sprint readiness
  • Ability to outline test scenarios and UAT criteria, ensuring delivered features meet business expectations
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Workfront)

Cross-Functional Leadership & Alignment

  • Ability to lead and influence across Sales, RevOps, Finance, Engineering, and Architecture without direct authority
  • Experience driving alignment on scope, priorities, and definitions across complex collaborator groups
  • Comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership and governance forums (e.g., PRB/ARB)

Analytical & Problem-Solving

  • Strong capability to detect problems in data, process, or system build
  • Experience using data to drive product decisions, prioritization, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to recognize root causes of business and system challenges and convert them into actionable solutions

Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Experience managing products through full lifecycle (discovery → definition → delivery → release → optimization)
  • Strong focus on detail with the capability to handle dependencies, risks, and delivery schedules
  • Ability to balance run-the-business priorities with central initiatives

If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
